messages:
alex: FYI — benchmark regression on mistral-7b when using sliding-window decode beyond 2048 tokens, ~25% higher p95. Looks tied to kernel selection + KV pointer churn.
maya: ugh, when did this start? regression relative to which commit?
alex: started after kernelselector change (commit 94e3). Benchmarked with `./perf/run_bench --model mistral-7b --seq 4096 --batch 1` on p4d; numbers:

``
old: p50 160ms, p95 310ms
new: p50 200ms, p95 390ms
```

jon: can you paste the kernelselector logs? especially the `selector.debug` output
alex: pasted below:

``
[selector] seq_len=4096 selected_kernel=attn_unfused_v2 reason=latency_estimate
[selector] kv_ptr_mode=sliding_window
[exec] memcpy_count=12, kv_allocs=3
```

maya: memcpy_count=12 seems high. sliding-window should reuse KV, not reallocate that often
rachel: might be due to RoPE position scaling change — we added clamping at 2048 which forces fallbacks
alex: confirmed: if we set `--rope-scale=1.0` perf goes back to baseline. With our current `rope_scale=0.75` the runtime picks `attn_unfused_v2` which doesn't stream KV efficiently
jon: can we try a quick patch to kernelselector: prefer streaming-compatible kernel when seq > max_pos/2 and kv_mode=sliding_window?
rachel: +1 — that heuristic matches expected workload
perf-bot: perf run queued: https://perf/reports/1769991234
alex: quick numbers after heuristic patch on same rig:

``
p50 165ms, p95 325ms
```

jon: that's promising. What's the tradeoff for short sequences? any regression at seq=512?
alex: negligible (within noise). For seq=512 p95 changed from 65ms -> 66ms
maya: we should also add a microbench for KV pointer churn — the memcpy_count should be instrumented
alex: added counters: `kv_copy_ops` and `kv_reuse_hits`

``
before: kv_copy_ops=12, kv_reuse_hits=4
after:  kv_copy_ops=2,  kv_reuse_hits=14
```

rachel: nice. We should run full CI with quantized kernels too (8-bit) — some kernels don't support q4h
jon: also check mask handling: there was an off-by-one where `attention_mask[:, :, :pos]` ended up zeroing a prefix for sliding window
alex: found it — mask build used `min(seq, max_pos)` instead of `seq - window_stride` in fastpath. Fix ready in branch `m7b/rope-kv-fix`
maya: can you open a PR and attach the perf logs + selector dump? assign to eng-runtime
alex: PR opened: https://git/repo/pull/422 (linked perf report & nsight capture)
rachel: assign to me for review. After merge let's roll to canary for dedicated infra
perf-bot: nsight capture uploaded: https://perf/nsys/1769991234
alex: next steps: merge heuristic, add unit test for `kv_reuse_hits`, add kernelselector opt flag `--prefer-streaming` (default=false) for now
jon: +1. I'm going to run the rope-scaling matrix across mistral-7b/8x7b tomorrow and check head/kv dim interactions
maya: thanks all. great debugging session :tada:
infra-bot: deploying canary build to prod-dedicated-1 in 10m
rachel: will monitor latency dashboards, ping here on anomalies
alex: closing the loop — will update thread with canary numbers
